data.name: Headline
data.value: Your gateway to jobs and opportunities in Palestine

data.name: Subtitle
data.value: We automatically bring together jobs, training opportunities, tenders and procurement notices from multiple websites in one place.

data.name: SummaryNote
data.value: Brief summary; full application conditions are at the original source.

data.value: Your report was received for administrator review.

data.value: Sign-in failed. Check your credentials or try later.

data.value: Aim for at most 200 characters in the original language; longer text can still be saved.

data.name: SourcesNote
data.value: A URL is not enough: configure and test listing, detail and pagination rules before enabling.

data.name: SourceLinkNote
data.value: No CVs or tender submissions are collected. Apply through the original source.

data.name: PrivacyText
data.value: We collect permitted opportunity listings and retain reports and operational logs for review. Summaries do not replace the original terms. Report errors or request content removal. We do not guarantee acceptance or continued availability; verify at the source.

data.name: CollectWorkerNote
data.value: The worker processes requests automatically; it must be running.

data.value: Collection queued for this source only. Track its status below.

data.name: CollectNotApproved
data.value: Enable the source and record its usage approval before collecting.

data.value: This source already has a pending or running request.

data.name: Request_Completed

data.name: AutomaticSourceHelp
data.value: Automatic discovery: enter the opportunity listing URL. JSON is optional; the host comes from the URL. Uncertain layouts require review.

data.name: RoundTotals
data.value: Link discovery finished. Source item totals (pending does not mean published):

data.name: Error_AttachmentCount

data.value: Have a question about the site or feedback on a listing? Send a message so we can reply by email. Applications are made through the original source.

data.name: ContactChanged
data.value: The message changed. Review its current status and try again.

data.name: ContactReceived
data.value: Your message was received. Thank you for contacting us.

data.name: AboutIntro
data.value: Palestine Opportunities brings together jobs, training, tenders and procurement opportunities related to Palestine.

data.name: AboutSources
data.value: We display concise information and links to original announcements. Check the publisher for application requirements, deadlines and updates, and apply through the original source.

data.name: ContactReplySubject
data.value: Reply to your message to Palestine Opportunities

data.name: ContactPrivacyNote
data.value: Your name, email and message are visible only to site administrators to follow up on your enquiry.

data.name: AboutOffer
data.value: Choose an opportunity type from the navigation, then narrow the results by search, location and category.

data.name: ContactPrivacyText
data.value: When you submit the contact form, we store your name, email and message so administrators can follow up and reply. These details are not displayed on public pages.

data.name: ReplyEmailNote
data.value: Reply opens your default email app, or you can use Gmail. Send the reply from your own account, then mark the message as handled.

data.name: AboutSourcesTitle
data.value: The original announcement is the reference

data.name: PageEditorHelp
data.value: Enter the title and text for each language. Line breaks and paragraphs are preserved. An empty field uses its default text. Content is plain text; HTML is not executed.

data.name: PageTitleLength
data.value: The page title must not exceed 200 characters.

data.name: PageContentsHelp
data.value: Manage public page text in Arabic and English. Saved changes are visible to visitors immediately.

data.name: PageEditConflict
data.value: This page was edited elsewhere. Reload it before saving another change.

data.name: MergeUndone
data.value: Merge undone; links and previous status restored.

data.name: Error_DateReview
data.value: The date value or event type could not be verified from its source quotation; inspect the evidence.

data.name: SystemDatesNote
data.value: Added and last-verified dates are system timestamps, separate from source dates.

data.name: ProposedDates
data.value: Dates proposed by the model — inspect evidence; not all dates are verified

data.name: Error_PdfOcrReview
data.value: This announcement uses OCR. Compare critical fields with the original PDF pages, then approve manually.

data.name: Error_PdfRead
data.value: PDF could not be read reliably. Inspect technical details and the original source, correct tool setup if needed, then retry.

data.name: ToolsIntro
data.value: Tool status from the worker environment. Checks run on request or daily at midnight Palestine time. Result timestamps are UTC; each result describes the tool at check time.

data.name: ToolsCheckAi
data.value: Live AI test — uses one request

data.name: ToolsAiCost
data.value: Standard checks do not call AI. A live test uses your account quota and appears in usage history; it never collects or publishes an opportunity.

data.name: ToolsWorkerOffline
data.value: No recent worker heartbeat. Start/restart the worker and check SQL, migrations and service logs. Requests stay queued.

data.name: ToolsMultipleWorkers
data.value: Multiple worker instances are active. Each result identifies its executor; a different instance is not current evidence for the displayed worker.

data.name: ToolsCollectorBusy
data.value: Worker is active and running a processing round. Its heartbeat is independent of round duration.

data.name: ToolsCollectorWaiting
data.value: Worker is active, polling queues or waiting for the schedule.

data.name: ToolsLastRunFailed
data.value: The last source run failed. Open Sources for its error; this does not mean the worker service stopped.

data.name: ToolsNotChecked
data.value: Not checked yet. Queue a check, then refresh results.

data.name: ToolsStale
data.value: This result is old or belongs to another worker instance. Request a new check.

data.name: ToolsLastAiNote
data.value: Last system-wide attempt: collection or a connectivity test, possibly from an earlier worker. It does not prove current configuration or publication quality.

data.name: ToolsCheckQueued
data.value: Check queued for the worker. Refresh shortly.

data.name: ToolsCheckAlreadyQueued
data.value: A matching check is queued/running, or was requested within the last minute.

data.name: ToolCode_AiKeyMissing

data.name: ToolCode_AiConfigured

data.name: ToolCode_AiInvalidResponse
data.value: AI response does not match the expected extraction structure.

data.value: AI unavailable. Check worker credentials, quota and model.

data.name: ToolCode_AiNetworkFailed
data.value: AI network request failed. Check connectivity or retry later.

data.name: ToolCode_BrowserMissing
data.value: Browser files are missing from the worker browser path.

data.value: Browser launch/execution failed. Check dependencies and service-account permissions.

data.name: ToolCode_ToolReady
data.value: Executable ran and reported its version.

data.name: ToolCode_VersionUnknown
data.value: Process ran, but the expected tool version could not be verified.

data.name: ToolCode_LanguagesReady

data.value: ara or eng is missing from the configured tessdata.

data.name: ToolCode_WorkspaceReady

data.name: ToolCode_CheckTimeout
data.value: Check timed out. Inspect the tool/network and retry.

data.name: ToolCode_ToolMissing
data.value: Executable missing or inaccessible. Check path and execute permissions.

data.name: ToolCode_ToolExecutionFailed
data.value: Tool execution failed. Check installation, dependencies and settings.

data.name: ToolCode_AccessFailed
data.value: Read, write or deletion failed. Check worker permissions and tool/temporary paths.

data.name: ToolCode_CheckFailed
data.value: Check could not complete. Review usage/worker logs and retry.

data.name: ToolOutcome_Interrupted
data.value: Interrupted; live AI is not retried automatically

data.name: ToolHelp_Collector
data.value: Inspect the worker service, SQL and logs; open Sources for individual source failures.

data.name: ToolHelp_AiConfiguration
data.value: This is worker configuration, which can differ from the website. Keys are never displayed.

data.name: ToolHelp_AiLive
data.value: Runs only through the live-test button. Connectivity does not measure extraction/publication quality.

data.name: ToolHelp_Chromium
data.value: Check PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH and Browser:Channel. Install the worker browser with --install-browser.

data.name: ToolHelp_PdfText
data.value: Check Pdf:TextExecutable, Poppler installation and its DLL dependencies.

data.name: ToolHelp_PdfRender
data.value: Check Pdf:RenderExecutable. OCR pages require pdftoppm.

data.name: ToolHelp_PdfLanguages
data.value: Install ara.traineddata and eng.traineddata in Pdf:OcrDataPath; check Pdf:EnableOcr.

data.name: ToolHelp_PdfWorkspace
data.value: Set Pdf:WorkDirectory outside wwwroot and grant worker create/delete access. A shared IIS archive is not needed.

data.name: ToolCode_PdfPipelineReady
data.value: Read a local two-page fixture: native English and scanned Arabic. No collection or publication.

data.name: ToolHelp_PdfPipeline
data.value: Exercises rendering, text extraction and OCR using a bundled fixture; it cannot guarantee every source document.

data.name: ToolCode_AiQuota
data.value: Provider returned 429: quota or rate limit currently unavailable.

data.name: ToolCode_AiAccessDenied
data.value: Provider denied access. Check credentials and account permissions.

data.name: ToolCode_AiModelUnavailable
data.value: Model/request unavailable. Check model name and request compatibility.

data.name: PdfFilesDeleted
data.value: PDF files and page images are deleted after processing. Extracted text and page references remain in the record; open the original source for visual comparison.
